liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The pre-drums second set is amazing, featuring a great transition into I Know You Rider [17]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Jerry is ripping it up on a great performance of this song [26]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Brent's crisp, soulful vocals complement Garcia, making this performance a key indicator of the show's quality [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-05-13.sbd.miller.25314.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 184 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1983-05-13.sbd.miller.95059.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 184 min; rated 3.4/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1983-05-13.167671.neumann.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 177 min [3]
- **gd1983-05-13.163382.nak304.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 175 min [5]
- **gd1983-05-13.fob.sonyecm220t.keshavan.miller.fix.94514.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 176 min; rated 4.71/5 by 7 [7]. Said about its sound: The recording features very nice sound quality, described as one of the better 1983 audience recordings; The recording quality is considered the best audience recording the reviewer has ever heard [16][19]
- **gd1983-05-13.nak700.mccue.32809.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 166 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [14]. Said about its sound: Phil is prominent in the mix, and the band is firing on all cylinders [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-05-13.sbd.miller.25314.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette [1]. Also: Good Lovin' is patched from an unknown generation audience source; no encore due to curfew [1]
- **gd1983-05-13.sbd.miller.95059.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> PCM -> Apogee Ensemble -> AIFF [2]. Also: Sony ECM-220T cassette master supplies Good Lovin'; Set 1 tunings patched from another source [2]
- **gd1983-05-13.167671.neumann.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Ken Kelley; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Ken Kelley's Master Audience Cassettes; Neumann mics (unknown model) > JVC KD-2 w/Super ANRS (Maxell XLII-S90) [3]. Also: Sony ECM 220T source supplies a patch in the Eyes of the World to Drums transition [3]
- **gd1983-05-13.163382.nak304.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics + CP4 capsules > Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes [5]. Also: Sony ECM220t source supplies crowd noise, Cold Rain & Snow start, and most of Drums [5]
- **gd1983-05-13.fob.sonyecm220t.keshavan.miller.fix.94514.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rango Keshavan; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B) [7]
- **gd1983-05-13.nak700.mccue.32809.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Mark McCue and Alex Ford; source: 2 Nak 700's > Bass Box EQ > Sony D5 > Sony D5 > Maxell MX 90's [14]
